title: Not Gold
text: Not Gold. I wish I had listened to another reviewer who mentioned how NOT gold this wick trimmer is. If you hold it in a certain light, you can see gold, but as a general rule, these definitely look silver.  Sending back. Don't waste your time if you are trying to match gold accessories.
